description: R3 replication on a different attention shape. head_dim 64 (vs 128) AND full MHA 32/32 (vs GQA 4:1) — two variables, so a confounded but real contrast. Chosen after granite-3.1-2b failed TP=4 sharding with IndivisibleError; SmolLM2's 32 kv heads divide by 4 cleanly.
note_occupancy: Occupancy is bounded to (0.5, 1.0] by the power-of-two ladder; B/2 is a bucket edge. Run e01 on the DEFAULT ladder — gap ladders give a far narrower range (gap=512 at B=4096 spans only 0.875-1.0).
